precepts.text: So out of the abundance of your heart, your mouth speaketh.
precepts.point: So the sixth place is understanding. And in the seventh, speech. The seventh is speech. The speech is the interpretation of what your mind meditates on. So out of the abundance of your heart, your mouth speaketh. These are the senses. Now read the next one. Verse six.

note.label: From Milk to Meat: Train All Your Senses

precepts.why:
Sirach names the senses the Most High gave man: “They received the use of the five operations of the Lord, and in the sixth place he imparted them understanding, and in the seventh speech, an interpreter of the cogitations thereof.” Cogitation is the act of thinking very carefully and deeply about a subject, or a carefully considered thought itself; meditation is a good word for it too, the capacity to think or reflect.

So the sixth is understanding and the seventh is speech, and speech is the interpretation of what your mind meditates on. That is why “out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.” What you meditate on is what comes out of your mouth.

Thinking and reflecting do not work unless they are funnelled through the word of God; that is how your mind has to work. If you are not moving right, the thought that comes out is going to be off, and so will the speech that interprets it.

The list goes on: “Counsel, and a tongue, and eyes, ears, and a heart, gave he them to understand. Withal he filled them with the knowledge of understanding, and shewed them good and evil.” The tongue is the instrument we use to form our words. Counsel is a man weighing options and determining what should be done, but he must be a godly man who surrounds himself with godly people. A mind fed on porn and then making decisions will make a mistake, and a mouth speaking out of that heart will show it. These senses are given so we can understand good and evil, and they have to be exercised in the word.

precepts.text: To them that repent he granted return, and comforted those that failed in patience.
precepts.point: The Pharisees asked why Christ ate with publicans and sinners, the same spirit as the Pharisee in Luke 18. They that be whole need not a physician: the law is not made for the righteous but for the sick, the lawless and whoremongers. I will have mercy and not sacrifice, from Hosea, and I am come to call sinners to repentance.

note.label: The Mercy and Humility of King Manasseh

precepts.why:
Manasseh prays, “For thou art the God, even the God of them that repent; and in me thou wilt shew all thy goodness: for thou wilt save me, that am unworthy, according to thy great mercy.” He is the God of them that repent.

Sirach shows what he does for them: “But unto them that repent, he granted them return, and comforted those that failed in patience.” Unto them that repent he grants return, return to the land. And he comforts those who failed in patience.

That is the goodness Manasseh expected God to show in him. He was unworthy, a king condemned on every count, but he repented, and the Lord brought him back again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. So it is for Israel as a nation: Manasseh is the living embodiment of the nation, and if we repent, he grants us return.

precepts.text: He gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage. That is the heritage lost in Jeremiah 17. Rudolph Windsor notes that when Israelites lose their nationality they discontinue from their heritage, because the laws follow the identity.
precepts.point: Our enemies are the enemies of God, the other nations. Here we are unapologetically biblical; take it up with God.

note.label: There Is No Hate Like Christian Love

precepts.why:
Jeremiah says Israel “shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not”. We have lost our heritage and we serve our enemies, one of the curses. Who are our enemies? All the other nations, the enemies of God. Christians do not want to hear that, but here we are unapologetically biblical. Take it up with God.

What is the heritage we lost? “Beside this he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage.” The law of life is the heritage we lost in Jeremiah 17. To take it, they had to break our bands asunder and separate us.

Rudolph R. Windsor, in From Babylon to Timbuktu, made mention that the Israelite culture is structured so that if you lose your nationality, you also discontinue from your heritage. We have a certain way of life as a certain people. When they strip you of your identity, what follows is your laws, statutes and commandments: you are not going to be performing the laws. Lose the identity and the heritage, the law of life, goes with it.

precepts.text: The heritage he gave was knowledge and the law of life, so what we were discontinued from is the law that gives life.
precepts.point: They knew Egypt, Babylon, Haran, Asia Minor and Syria. The land they did not know is where the slave ships went.

precepts.text: In the division of the nations he set a ruler over every people, but Israel is the Lord's portion.
precepts.point: For the Lord's portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance. In the division of the nations he set a ruler over every people, but Israel he kept for himself: that is my inheritance, that is my portion.

note.label: Deuteronomy 32: The Song of Moses, Prophecy of Israel's Fall and the Most High's Vengeance

precepts.why:
“When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.” You thought God wants everybody to just come together and hold hands? The God of this Bible has been a God of division from day one. He separated the sons of Adam according to where he had to place the children of Israel, meaning this world revolves around Israel.

Ecclesiasticus shows the division: “For in the division of the nations of the whole earth he set a ruler over every people; but Israel is the Lord’s portion”. Every people got a ruler set over them, but Israel he kept for himself. That is “the Lord’s portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance”: that is my inheritance, that is my portion.

precepts.text: We are told to return to the Most High, forsake our sins, and offend less in the things we are battling.
precepts.point: Lord, I have hoped for Thy salvation, and done Thy commandments. My soul hath kept Thy testimonies, and I love them exceedingly. I have kept Thy precepts and Thy testimonies, for all my ways are before Thee.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

precepts.why:
“Return unto the Lord, and forsake thy sins, make thy prayer before his face, and offend less.” Great peace have they which love the law and nothing shall offend them, but sometimes we do get offended, and that is part of our pilgrimage. So we are told to return to the Most High, forsake our sins, and offend less in the things we are battling.

Repentance is a two part step: confessing and forsaking. It is done with counsel, seeking it from leadership rather than covering our sins.

precepts.text: He gave them knowledge and the law of life for an heritage, to bring us back to life.
precepts.point: These are the curses we are under. Our heritage, the heathens, became our masters and our oppressors today. We are still under the curses of God, disconnected from our blessings and from our homeland.

note.label: Psalm 127: Except the Lord Build the House

precepts.why: “Beside this he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage.” Knowledge and the law of life are our heritage as well, given to bring us back to life. Children are an heritage of the Lord, and the law of life is the heritage that restores a people disconnected from theirs.

points: Return unto the Lord, and forsake thy sins, make thy prayer before his face, and offend less. Here is the first solution: offend less. God does not expect you to come into the truth and just be perfect. But can you go a week without watching porn? You passed a week: try two weeks. You did two: go three, then four, then five, then six months, then a year. And if you fall, get back up and keep going; do not just keep falling because you fell once after two months clean.

When you offend less, the demon becomes less strong. The more you feed it, the stronger it gets, like an addiction, and the harder it is to stop. But if you start starving the demon, week after week, it weakens. It is a heavy addiction, and the withdrawal is real, but you starve it out.

Every man from his youth is given unto evil. They know that from the time we're born, we're given to evil. So with that understanding, they're able to put homosexuality in cartoons; they're able to steer your children, if you're not careful about how you rear them up, in the direction they need them to go to provide sweat equity in the future.

Children are the most sought after prey to become victims to predators of criminal behavior. Their thought patterns are going to change; they're going to choose to go that way because they've already been wired into it by your television and your phones, and you will watch your children transform into demons right before you.

The way the media is shaped, you cannot get attention as a doctor, an architect, an engineer, or even a decent father. They suppress the proper imagery; that's why they knocked Cosby off. But shoot em up videos get billions of views. Our people love attention because we've been deprived of attention all our lives, so manhood got redefined and rewired. Criminal profilers tell you that once criminals do something heinous, they hope to find their case on the news; they get a high off the affirmation, because that's the only way they've been reduced to getting attention.

Look at what they do to IUIC for an example. We went into Englewood in Chicago, one of the roughest parts, and brothers on the side said, you don't recognize what you just did; you stopped violence for two hours. The media was there with their cameras and didn't put up one second of what we did. But when we left and shootings took place, the cameras got that and put that up. We understand the game, and we're trying to make sure you understand the game.

The woman involved was the honeypot. Definition read in class: a honeypot refers to a female operative who uses romantic or sexual attraction as a trap in espionage, sting operations, or blackmail; a honey trap entices a target into a false relationship to extract information, gather evidence, or ruin a reputation. She let the crew know exactly where he was at all points. She's in the courtroom and she gets 15 years, and she didn't touch a gun or anything. That's Florida; they don't have parole in Florida. She won't get out until about 40, no children, no husband, and by then starting a family is damn near nonexistent at that age, with that history behind her.

That's the game itself. You mean to tell me the prosecutor doesn't know there's no parole in Florida? She knew. They wanted him to hear that, to break him. Esau is the devil for a reason; you're not going to out demonic him. He'll let a young man run around thinking he's terrorizing something, and say, let him destroy his own people, but when we get him, we've got him. They were just waiting on him.

The prosecution was originally going for the death penalty. But on death row, with appeals, he might sit 15 or 20 years; they have to feed him, house him, give him medical care, roughly 70 to 80 thousand dollars a year per inmate. They said no, we don't want that. Give him life without parole, and he works for pennies to earn his commissary until he leaves in a body bag. That's money the prison saves.

He heard "we need that sweat equity" and started rubbing his eyes, about to cry. They talked about him like he wasn't even in the room, but they knew he heard it. All that psychological torture brought down all the tough talk. Where were the gangster videos then? When you get locked up, nobody cares about you; whatever friends didn't go down with you are gone. He set up a GoFundMe to appeal the case and couldn't even collect 800 dollars. Nobody gave a damn.

This society is about making us slaves. The victim is dead, and the five involved are going to prison; that's six people out of the way, and the ones remaining become fuel. Once that gavel swings, your name is gone. The name on your birth certificate doesn't exist anymore. You become property of the state, and the 13th Amendment tells them what to do with you: involuntary servitude, slavery, sweat equity.

The 13th Amendment, Section 1: neither slavery nor involuntary servitude, except as a punishment for crime whereof the party shall have been duly convicted. That's the loophole. When they abolished slavery, where was the fuel going to come from? The freed labor. Most of our people were happy with the top part of it, not realizing the society itself was set up to shape you into breaking laws.

Convict leasing: a system of forced penal labor prevalent in the southern United States from the 19th century until the mid 20th century, under which state and local governments leased incarcerated people, the vast majority of whom were black men, to private corporations and individuals to work for a fee. If you can't get a job and can't feed your family, people are reduced to crime, and when they go into so-called crime, they said, we got you now; now we get to use you as a slave, which is what we always wanted from the beginning of this country. America could not do without slaves, so they gave slavery by another name.

A slave auction bill from Banks' Arcade: Mary, aged 18 years, a field hand; Harriet, aged 21; Priscilla, aged 33, field hand and fair cook; Lewis, aged 24, wagoner; John Wilkinson, aged 28, number one dining room servant; Elizabeth, aged 20, fine washer and ironer and fair cook. Listen to how they describe the property, like features on a car you buy on a lot. Notice the ages: none of them are 45 or 60, because this is prime work, sweat equity. That's how they talked about us.

Dred Scott v. Sandford, December term 1856, read from the court record: a free negro of the African race, whose ancestors were brought to this country and sold as slaves, is not a citizen within the meaning of the Constitution of the United States. When the Constitution was adopted, they were not regarded in any of the states as members of the community which constituted the state, and were not numbered among its people or citizens; consequently the special rights and immunities guaranteed to citizens do not apply to them. The only two clauses in the Constitution which point to this race treat them as persons whom it was morally lawful to deal in as articles of property and to hold as slaves. No state can by any subsequent law make a foreigner or any other description of persons citizens of the United States; and the change in public opinion and feeling in relation to the African race which has taken place since the adoption of the Constitution cannot change its construction and meaning, and it must be construed and administered according to its true meaning and intention when it was formed and adopted.

That's the game. Even if they give you civil rights to make you think you're on an equal footing, the Constitution comes back and says that will not make you a citizen. That's why you had to have voting rights acts and all the rest. That's why people can be shot down and left in the street with nobody held to account. Our children are being fooled into thinking they can do all kinds of wickedness and be all right, and the Constitution is already set up to lock them up and get sweat equity out of them.

Every sin is a gateway. Porn means fornicate, and it evolves from man and woman to worse; cigarettes become vaping and Black and Milds, weed becomes lacing and pills, a sip becomes alcoholism. Wean yourself off over time, relapse or not.

Eating, drinking, sleeping around, anger, drugs, and for sisters attention and social media are outlets for unresolved things. Scrolling shorts shortens your attention and your intellect until you cannot read a book; learn to fight these off.
